<MethodEndpoint

Requires `maintainer`, same reason as the parallelism cap: this is an INDEPENDENT, additive check next to the project and session budgets (ADR 0110) — not a cascade, and not a replacement for either. The limit comes in as DOLLARS and is converted to micro-USD server-side, same convention as `BudgetsController`. `null` clears the cap.
